note: Small gravel-lot RV park on the Business 49 loop off I-49 near Butler, formerly Diehl's Corner; an overnight stop with long-stay guests among them. No website; booking by phone. --Claude
summary: No operator website or booking engine exists; presence passes on Google Maps (4.7 stars / 108 reviews, phone 816-835-6093). No rate anywhere (RV Life $$, avg $28). Cleared directory-only hookups, site count/pull-through and year-round. Long-stay character flagged for a human.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): rate - none posted (no operator site; RV Life $$ tier, avg_rate $28); Good Sam - not in the directory within 2.5 km; gateway - none within 40 km (Kansas City 89 km), so a rate over $50 would fail; presence passes only via Google Maps: open listing 'Show-Me Rest RV Park', 7045 NE Business 49 Loop, Butler, 4.7 stars / 108 reviews, phone 816-835-6093 (matches the entry), no website. RV Life 4.5 stars (5 on 8 ratings in the index).

LONG-STAY CHARACTER (no weekly/monthly marketing to read, since no operator page exists): Google reviews read include 'My husband & his crew are working in this area for the next few months and this is where they are staying' (4 years ago) beside transient ones - 'Perfect for a overnight stopping point' (4 years ago), 'Just stayed one night but we slept well and the price was very reasonable', a stay after driving from Florida (a year ago), 'This campground was a God send' and 'Great place to stay, amazing owners' (4 months ago). Leaf-off (winter) Esri imagery shows ~12 rigs parked in the gravel lot of a park said to have 19 sites - high for the off-season, which may mean long-stay workers. Read as mixed transient/worker; if a human judges it long-stay in character, test 2 (posted nightly rate) fails and the RV Life tier does not stand in.
Missing website: none exists (stored website already empty). Passport America and Hipcamp list it as directory entries only; the Hipcamp page is 'Coming soon', no booking.
